ToggleGroup.description: A `<div>` with the `group` role that holds which of its toggles are pressed. It is one Tab stop: the arrow keys, Home and End move between its toggles. Inside a toolbar the toolbar owns the keyboard instead.

props.value: The values of the pressed toggles. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the group. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.
props.defaultValue: The values pressed at first, when the group isn't controlled. None by default.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new array of pressed values when a toggle is pressed or released, in a change of its own: it may be an action that saves without holding the group.
props.multiple: Whether several toggles can be pressed at once. Without it, pressing one releases the other.
props.disabled: Disables every toggle in the group. The group is also disabled inside a disabled toolbar or toolbar group.
props.orientation: Which arrow keys move between the toggles: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight when `horizontal`, ArrowUp and ArrowDown when `vertical`.
props.loopFocus: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the group is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-multiple: Present when several toggles can be pressed at once.
